summary.zh: DeepSeek开源其生产推理栈DeepInfer，支持英伟达和华为硬件；MiniMax发布低成本百万上下文模型M3.1 Flash。
summary.en: DeepSeek open-sourced DeepInfer, its production inference stack supporting Nvidia and Huawei hardware; MiniMax released M3.1 Flash.

title.zh: 美国国土安全部要求联邦机构移除DeepSeek产品
title.en: DHS orders DeepSeek off federal systems

summary.zh: 美国国土安全部命令联邦民事机构移除DeepSeek产品及相关第三方服务；微软推出Guardian Agents监控企业智能体。
summary.en: DHS ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products; Microsoft introduced Guardian Agents to monitor enterprise agents.

title.zh: 特朗普希望由泽连斯基以外人士代表乌克兰谈判
title.en: Trump wants someone other than Zelenskyy to negotiate

summary.zh: 特朗普呼吁由泽连斯基以外的人代表乌克兰进行谈判。
summary.en: Trump called for someone other than Zelenskyy to negotiate for Ukraine.

title.zh: 加拿大艾伯塔省公投预计选择留在加拿大
title.en: Alberta projected to vote to stay in Canada

summary.zh: 预测显示艾伯塔省公投结果为留在加拿大。
summary.en: Alberta was projected to vote to remain in Canada.

title.zh: 世界粮食计划署将加沙粮援削减三分之一
title.en: WFP cuts Gaza food aid by a third

summary.zh: 因资金短缺，世界粮食计划署将加沙粮食援助削减三分之一；英国威胁制裁与非法定居点相关的企业和个人。
summary.en: WFP cut Gaza food aid by a third amid funding shortages; the UK threatened sanctions over illegal West Bank settlements.

title.zh: 布伦特原油升破每桶110美元

summary.zh: 阿纳多卢报道，布伦特原油价格升至每桶110美元以上。
summary.en: Brent crude climbed above $110 a barrel, Anadolu reported.

title.zh: 企业财报强劲 道指涨逾1%

summary.zh: 10月20日道指涨1.02%至52495.88点，Equifax、孩之宝等财报亮眼，纳指基本持平。
summary.en: The Dow rose 1.02% to 52,495.88 on Oct. 20 on strong results from Equifax, Hasbro and others; the Nasdaq was flat.

title.zh: 李强出席上合组织成员国政府首脑理事会第二十五次会议
title.en: Li Qiang attends SCO heads of government meeting

summary.zh: 李强出席上合组织总理理事会第二十五次会议，并会见伊朗第一副总统和白俄罗斯总理。
summary.en: Li Qiang attended the 25th SCO heads of government meeting and met Iran's first vice president and Belarus's PM.

title.zh: 前三季度规模以上工业增加值同比增长5.3%
title.en: Industrial output up 5.3% in three quarters

summary.zh: 前三季度规模以上工业增加值同比增长5.3%；丁薛祥出席国家数据集团成立大会。
summary.en: Industrial value added rose 5.3% in three quarters; Ding Xuexiang attended the launch of the National Data Group.
